data.description:
Every new surface created inside a workspace should start in that workspace's root directory. Today only the socket launch-agent rail honors Workspace.rootDirectory (precedence: explicit --cwd, workspace root, launching surface). The tab-bar agent button (launchDefaultAgentFromTabBar, default-agent launch), new terminal tab, every split, and CLI new-surface/split all inherit the focused shell's cwd via inheritedCwdForAgentLaunch / panelDirectories, so a workspace titled "c11" with root code/c11 launched a new agent in code/overwatch because one surface had cd'd there (observed 2026-09-26, workspace index 3: root_directory=code/c11, current_directory=code/overwatch).

Operator decisions (Atin, 2026-09-26):
1. Root is a workspace-level attribute; panes and splits are sub-attributes. Every rail snaps to the root: new terminal tab, split, tab-bar agent button, default-agent launch, launch-agent, CLI new-surface/split. Precedence everywhere: explicit cwd, then workspace root, then focused surface, then home. Reuse AgentLaunchWorkingDirectoryResolver.resolve as the single seam; delete per-rail precedence.
2. Root is visible and editable in the GUI: an info affordance on the workspace (sidebar row or title bar) that shows the root and lets the operator change or clear it, backed by the existing set-workspace-root socket verb. Show the focused surface's cwd only as a secondary line when it differs from the root, so drift is visible.
3. Auto-establish: a workspace created with a directory already gets it as root (TabManager.addWorkspace establishRootFromWorkingDirectory). A workspace created without one adopts its first terminal surface's reported cwd as root, so no workspace stays rootless. Session restore keeps the persisted root.
4. list-workspaces --json already reports root_directory; add root to `c11 tree` workspace lines and keep get/set symmetric (a get-workspace-root or equivalent read).

Acceptance: with a workspace whose root is A and a focused surface cd'd to B, a new tab, a split, the agent button, and `c11 launch-agent` without --cwd all start in A; `--cwd C` still wins; the info affordance shows A and changing it to D makes the next surface start in D; a workspace created from the sidebar with no directory acquires a root after its first shell reports a cwd. Unit tests on the resolver and on addWorkspace root establishment; smoke on the real packaged app per SMOKE convention.
data.title: c11: workspace root directory governs every new surface (tabs, splits, agent button, CLI), visible and editable from the workspace

Code review (single, art_01M3FVMHXH0CQ1Q0YPNPDEMV8Q) FAIL implementation-level, 1 Major + 7 Minor, triaged in plan Amendment 2 and fixed in 8e8db2037: shared Workspace.usableRootDirectory used by the seam, launch-agent, and new-workspace placement; explicit cwd skips the root stat; get_root stats off-main; drift-safe new-workspace placement (Orchestrator ruling: start in the selected workspace's root); string-only menu drift compare; dead fallback removed; tests for the agent-button cwd, the replacement terminal, new-workspace placement, usableRootDirectory, and comparablePath. Not yet compiled: partial resume forbids builds. Build, local logic tests, and runtime re-checks wait for FULL RESUME.

Completion (C11-238-Delegator-1). PR #453 https://github.com/Stage-11-Agentics/c11/pull/453, head c0fb81bc6, rebased on origin/main 9488affae.

What changed: one cwd seam (Workspace.newSurfaceWorkingDirectory: explicit, usable root, source surface, home) inside every TerminalPanel construction site, so tabs, splits, the tab-bar split and agent buttons, repair and replacement panels, new-surface/new-split/new-pane, and default-agent launch all start in the root. launch-agent shares the missing-root rule via Workspace.usableRootDirectory. --cwd honored on default-agent launch (it was dropped) and added to new-surface. Auto-establish: one-shot adoption of the focused shell's first cwd other than ~ and /, persisted, disarmed by any set or clear. GUI: title-bar info popover and a sidebar Workspace Root submenu. CLI: get-workspace-root, root= in c11 tree. Docs, skills (c11, lattice-orchestrator; installed copies synced), six locales.

Deviations and decisions: (1) auto-adopt skips ~ and / (Orchestrator-approved assumption). (2) New workspaces without a directory start in the selected workspace's root, falling back to its focused cwd (Orchestrator ruling: drift never becomes a root); applies to addWorkspace and the New Workspace sheet pre-fill. (3) Runtime proof was on the tagged Debug build per the boot prompt, not a Release staging pass. (4) The installed c11 skill already describes this branch (get-workspace-root, new-surface --cwd) ahead of a release. (5) Tests trimmed per Atin: pure logic tests plus host WorkspaceRootDirectoryTests; the full attemptAgentSurfaceLaunch path is covered by a side-effect-free resolution test and the real button click. Host tests had not run anywhere when the PR opened; CI's build job is their first run.

Smoke by hand: in a rooted workspace, cd a shell elsewhere; Cmd+T, Cmd+D, the A button, and a tab-bar split should each start in the root. Open the title-bar info button: the drift line should show; Use Focused Directory then Clear should each govern the next terminal. Check the sidebar row's Workspace Root submenu in minimal mode.

Orchestrator merge review (Cairn-1). PR #453 squash-merged to main as eca449694.

Fresh-context reviewer (Opus, read-only, full diff against origin/main): nothing above Minor. The shared cwd seam (Workspace.newSurfaceWorkingDirectory) is used by every GUI rail traced: tab, + tab, split, tab-bar split button, drag-split replacement, last-panel replacement, A button, default-agent launch, and socket new-surface, new-split, new-pane. Socket agent.launch skips a deleted root and stats it off-main. Session restore keeps the persisted root and the armed/cleared state. Localization keys present in all locales. Popover reserves space, nothing jumps.

Gates: CI green (build, compat-tests, mailbox-unit, drawbridge, python-syntax, web-typecheck, remote-daemon, workflow-guard). Runtime proof attached (art_01M3FYEZYK8TMA4M9PE5ESPFA2). PR head c0fb81bc6 == branch head. Operator direction: minimize new tests and ship.

Minors carried to a follow-up ticket rather than blocking the merge: snapshot/blueprint capture pins a cleared or deleted root; socket workspace.create with root_directory null plus cwd stays armed and adopts cwd; remote workspaces get a remote path as local cwd and the editor is offered on them; launch-agent's third fallback differs from other rails; surface.create validates cwd for non-terminal types; main-thread stat of the root on hung network mounts; sidebar menu lacks a missing-root marker; docs overclaim that a drifted shell never seeds a new workspace when the selected workspace has no root; a few claimed behaviors untested.
